line.comment: * ** Add-Ons 1.6: Changed base chances as follows: ***
* Add-Ons 2.1.1: Common chance decreased (79% -> 74%) to add new anomalous rarity (5% chance)
* Uncommon: 10% -> 20%
* Anomalous: 5%
* Rare: 1% (unchanged, but now increases by 1% (up to a max of 10%) every time a common is selected)
* Add-Ons 2.1: Echoes of the Hive quest.
* The first rare terraforming effect generated becomes the Ancient Kha'ak Hive.
* Only one Hive may exist per game.
* If no planet rolls a rare effect, the Hive will not generate. This is intentional.
* Add-Ons 2.1.1: Gaia worlds spawn only in dejure and Terran Memory sectors.
* Update purpose: if ongoing or terraformed, we don't reset it.
* Effect array:
* [0] = effect ID
* [1] = reserved
* [2] = reserved
* ** Herobetty 5.3: First version of terraforming overhaul: ***
* 1. Removed weak re-roll. Changed super reroll.
* 2. Removed reputation, hacking (called "healing"), favor, maintenance, and perk effects.
* 3. Set amounts of population, support, and research to compensate.
* 4. Rarity system. Effects are divided into common, uncommon, anomalosu, and rare pools.
* Add-Ons 1.2: Added uncommon effects to the pool.
* ****** TERRAFORMING EFFECTS ********
* Herobetty 5.1: Common tier.
* Decrease the common chance by 1%. This will also increase the rare chance by 1%.
* However, if common chance has already decreased by 9% (chance of getting a rare now at 10%), don't decrease further.
* Herobetty 5.1: Population now gives a fixed +20 pops.
* Herobetty 5.1: Support now gives a fixed +2 support.
* Herobetty 5.1: Research now gives a fixed +30% research rate.
* +100% ship repair rate (Outpost)
* Herobetty 5.1: Removed hacking. +100% Outpost E-Cell production (requires solar panels perk)
* Herobetty 5.1: +100% Outpost Food production.
* Herobetty 5.1: Removed favor. +100% Outpost Waste production.
* Herobetty 5.1: Split Ecells, food, waste, and tax into separate RNG categories. This category is now solely for tax (+100% Outpost Tax).
* Herobetty 5.1: Removed maintenance. Replaced with increased population growth rate.
* +5 pop growth rate
* Herobetty 5.1: Removed EMP cooldown. Replaced with specialization.
* Specialization perk reduced from +5% to +3% (+5% now belongs to epic tier). See Mayhem.GetMaxSpecializationLevel.xml for the change.
* Herobetty 5.1: Uncommon tier
* Herobetty 5.1: +30 pops and 60% of the standard growth rate perk (+3 pop growth rate instead of +5 pop growth rate).
* Herobetty 5.1: +4 station support
* Herobetty 5.1: +60% research rate
* Herobetty 5.1: +100% repair rate at outpost and +2 station support.
* Herobetty 5.1: All 4 economy perks in 1: EC, waste, food, and tax but +50% each instead of +100%.
* +5% max specialization. See Mayhem.GetMaxSpecializationLevel.xml for the change.
* +1% research rate for every 5 maximum population.
* +1 max population for every 5% sector research, excluding Faster research.
* Add-Ons 2.1.1: Anomalous tier
* These planets require TE3 to complete, but they provide specialized effects that may synergize with rare effects.
* Terraforming bonus is 35% instead of 25%.
* +50% recycling speed.
* +30 Ore and +30 Silicon per minute. Goods are given once every Outpost consumption cycle.
* Add-Ons 1.2: Rare tier
* Reset the common chance back to normal.
* Add-Ons 2.1: New Kha'ak Hive Quest.
* The first rare effect becomes the Ancient Kha'ak Hive. Only one Hive can exist per game.
* Initially shows as "Unknown..."
* Upon recycling a Kha'ak ship, starts the Kha'ak Hive Quest. Effect description becomes "Ancient Kha'ak Hive."
* Upon terraforming AND defeating the raid, description becomes "Ancient Kha'ak Hive: Enables Kha'ak ship construction..."
* If the quest fails, description becomes "Ruins of an Ancient Kha'ak Hive."
* Standard rare effects. If in a dejure OR terran memory sector, then Gaia Worlds are allowed to spawn in.
* +10 stat points to all newly recruited marines. (Add-Ons 2.0: Buffed from +5 to +10)
* 10% more recycling factor (stacks with capital shipyard) and 10% more research gained from recycling.
* +40 Teladianium per minute. Goods are given once every Outpost consumption cycle.
* +25 Rastar Oil per minute. Goods are given once every Outpost consumption cycle.
* +60 Ore per minute. Goods are given once every Outpost consumption cycle.
* +60 Silicon per minute. Goods are given once every Outpost consumption cycle.
* Add-Ons 2.1.1: New Tomb World effect:
* Periodically salvages all shipbuilding materials, but provides no generic terraforming bonus upon completion.
* Add-Ons 2.1.1: New Gaia World effect:
* Terraforming bonus is 50% instead of 25%.
